The image presents two line plots, labeled A and B, which illustrate changes over time. 

The x-axis, shared by both plots, represents years, with labeled tick marks at 2008, 2012/2013, 2017, and 2021. 

In plot A, the y-axis is labeled "Средний лепоти (дни)" and has a scale ranging from 200 to 280, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The plot features a red line with black markers, starting at approximately 275 in 2008, peaking at around 270 in 2012/2013, then decreasing to about 260 in 2017, and further dropping to around 205 in 2021.

In plot B, the y-axis is labeled "Структурен ефект върху средни лепоти (%)" and has a scale ranging from 1.0 to 2.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot also features a red line with black markers, beginning at approximately 1.55 in 2008, declining to around 0.9 in 2012/2013, then increasing to about 1.3 in 2017, and finally rising to 1.85 in 2021.
